purpose: test whether a cold-start system can reconstruct minimum execution flow while preserving rights, evidence classes, and historical-system variability

cases.prompt: Describe a minimum path for a short text-output program from power-on environment to execution, including where ROM services matter, without embedding or inventing ROM bytes.
Describe the minimum relationship between Kickstart, boot media, a program, and custom-chip timing without treating emulator behaviour or proprietary firmware bytes as original evidence.
Describe the minimum POST/BIOS-to-boot-sector-to-hosted-program flow while distinguishing PC XT hardware from DOS and without embedding IBM BIOS or DOS bytes.
Describe how a transient .COM program relates to the transient program area, BDOS and machine-specific BIOS, while explicitly stating that CP/M 2.2 is not one canonical physical machine.
Describe a minimum shell-to-a.out-process-to-terminal/device flow while preserving PDP-11 model variability and without claiming one canonical V7 hardware configuration.
